# Audio Assets Directory

You can optionally place custom MP3 files here:
- `background.mp3`: Ambient celestial music
- `clock.mp3`: Mechanical clock ticking
- `heart.mp3`: Heartbeat pulse sound
- `whoosh.mp3`: Cinematic universe transit sound
- `explosion.mp3`: Climax clock explosion

*Note: If no custom MP3 files are placed here, the application automatically uses its built-in Web Audio API procedural sound synthesizers with zero configuration!*
